t: This is Swiss Cottage Library on Avenue Road, a public library in Camden and an architectural landmark. It was built between 1963 and 1964 and designed by Sir Basil Spence of Spence, Bonnington and Collins. Spence was a Scottish architect, best known for Coventry Cathedral in England and the Beehive in New Zealand. He worked in the Modernist and Brutalist style, and this library is one of his many other buildings.
